body.name: \(\Gamma\)
body.construction: \(\Gamma=(\tau,\ell,S_\ell,\operatorname{inc}_\ell,\Omega_\ell,\theta^-,\theta^+,p^*,I_{\partial},\Delta_q,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), where \(\tau\) is the complete deterministic recursion trace, \(\ell\) is the preserved original-cycle label, each algebraic coordinate of \(\theta^\pm\) has a minimal polynomial and isolating rational interval, \(p^*=\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+)\), \(I_{\partial}\) lists all matched boundary primitive-event probabilities, and \(\Delta_q=H(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)-H(\theta^+)K(\theta^-)\ne0\).
